record.field: purpose: read the Borg status report per LXD artifact on a host when: first step for any Borg/backup question — is the newest archive fresh, or stale? when not: to run a backup (use borg_backup_run); to inspect the repo (use borg_list) example: {"minion": "fors"} output: status JSON per host — {host, repo, status (ok|warning|error), artifacts, stale, items[]} where each item = {kind, name, last, age_hours, archive, size_bytes, original_size_bytes, files} guardrail: read-only operation, safe

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"LXD host minion ID (fors, tull0, strand)"},"format":{"type":"string","description":"json (default) or txt — txt is the human-readable report","default":"json"}},"required":["minion"]}

async def execute(minion, format="json"): """Read the Borg status report (per artifact) from an LXD host.""" api = env['saltstack.api'] ext = "json" if format == "json" else "txt" return api.salt_call( "local", minion, "cmd.run", f"cat /var/log/lxd-backup/lxd-backup-status.{ext}")

purpose: list the archives in a Borg repo, optionally filtered by prefix when: to answer "which restore points exist for this container/host?" before a restore when not: for the per-artifact health summary (use borg_status); to restore (use borg_restore) example: {"minion": "fors", "prefix": "fors-containers-sparv"} output: archive names with timestamps (newest last) guardrail: read-only operation, safe

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"Host that owns the repo (fors, tull0, strand)"},"prefix":{"type":"string","description":"Archive prefix, e.g. <host>-<kind>-<name>. Empty = all archives","default":""},"limit":{"type":"integer","description":"Max number of archives to return (newest last)","default":20}},"required":["minion"]}

async def execute(minion, prefix="", limit=20): """List Borg archives in the LXD-backup repo on a host.""" api = env['saltstack.api'] glob = f"--glob-archives '{prefix}-*'" if prefix else "" cmd = ( "set -a; . /etc/lxd-backup/lxd-backup.conf; set +a; " f"borg list --format '{{archive}}{{TAB}}{{time}}{{NEWLINE}}' {glob} " f"\"$LXD_BACKUP_REPO\" 2>&1 | tail -n {int(limit)}" ) return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", cmd)

purpose: show which LXD artifacts the backup WOULD discover on a host (no backup is run) when: to verify discovery after adding a container, or when the status report misses an artifact when not: for the actual backup health (use borg_status) example: {"minion": "fors"} output: KIND / NAME / PATH per discovered artifact (containers, VMs, snapshots, custom volumes, buckets, lxd-db) guardrail: read-only operation, safe

async def execute(minion): """List the LXD artifacts that lxd-backup.sh discovers (dry discovery).""" api = env['saltstack.api'] return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", "/usr/local/bin/lxd-backup.sh --list")

purpose: run a Borg backup NOW on an LXD host (per artifact, or one kind) when: after a missed nightly run, or to verify a newly onboarded container backs up when not: as a routine action (nightly cron 01:00 handles it); without checking borg_status first example: {"minion": "fors"} or {"minion": "fors", "kind": "containers"} output: backup log per artifact (created archives, dedup stats) guardrail: requires human approval (destructive — writes to the repo, can take hours)

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"LXD host minion ID"},"kind":{"type":"string","description":"Limit to one kind: containers, vms, snapshots, custom, buckets, lxd-db. Empty = all","default":""}},"required":["minion"]}

purpose: run Borg retention (prune) on a host — Dirvish-compatible semantics when: to verify retention, or after pinning/unpinning an archive when not: routinely (cron runs dry-run Sunday 02:00 and real prune 03:00) example: {"minion": "fors", "dry_run": true} output: what was pruned (or WOULD be pruned with dry_run=true) guardrail: dry_run=true is safe; dry_run=false requires human approval (deletes archives) note: pinned archives (EXPIRES=Never in /etc/lxd-backup/hist/<prefix>.hist) are excluded from the prune glob and verified to still exist afterwards (exit 3 if gone)

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"LXD host minion ID"},"dry_run":{"type":"boolean","description":"true = only show what would be pruned (safe)","default":true}},"required":["minion"]}

async def execute(minion, dry_run=True): """Run lxd-backup-prune.sh (dry-run by default).""" api = env['saltstack.api'] flag = " --dry-run" if dry_run else "" return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", f"/usr/local/bin/lxd-backup-prune.sh{flag}")

purpose: pin (EXPIRES=Never) or unpin an archive so retention never deletes it when: for year archives / evidentiary value, or to protect an archive during an investigation when not: routinely — pinning accumulates storage example: {"minion": "fors", "archive": "fors-containers-sparv-2026-09-24T18:14:53", "unpin": false} output: confirmation that EXPIRES was set to Never (or restored to default) guardrail: requires human approval (changes retention — a pinned archive is kept forever)

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"LXD host minion ID"},"archive":{"type":"string","description":"Full archive name to pin/unpin"},"unpin":{"type":"boolean","description":"true = restore default EXPIRES instead of pinning","default":false}},"required":["minion","archive"]}

async def execute(minion, archive, unpin=False): """Pin or unpin a Borg archive (Dirvish Never semantics).""" api = env['saltstack.api'] flag = "--unpin" if unpin else "--pin" return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", f"/usr/local/bin/lxd-backup-prune.sh {flag} '{archive}'")

purpose: extract ONE LXD artifact from Borg to a target directory when: to recover a container/volume — the whole point of per-artifact backup when not: to restore the whole host (extract per artifact instead) example: {"minion": "fors", "artifact": "containers/sparv", "target": "/tmp/restore-sparv"} output: extracted files in <target> guardrail: requires human approval (writes to disk) IMPORTANT: this extracts to a DIRECTORY — it does NOT replace the container in LXD. To actually restore: 1) run this, 2) stop/delete the container in LXD, 3) move rootfs back to the pool path, 4) lxc start <name>. Steps 2-4 are manual on purpose — an automatic overwrite of a live container is too dangerous.

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"LXD host minion ID"},"artifact":{"type":"string","description":"<kind>/<name>, e.g. containers/sparv or custom/my-volume"},"target":{"type":"string","description":"Target directory (should be empty)"},"archive":{"type":"string","description":"Specific archive name. Empty = newest for that prefix","default":""}},"required":["minion","artifact","target"]}

purpose: read the Restic status report (per customer Garage bucket) when: first step for any S3/Garage backup question — which customers backed up, which failed? when not: for Borg/LXD host backups (use borg_status) example: {"minion": "restic"} output: per customer — source bucket + <customer>-backup bucket with size, plus a "Bucket-täckning" section (backed up / has data but no backup / other mechanism / empty) guardrail: read-only operation, safe note: restic backs up Garage S3 buckets to <customer>-backup. The Garage cluster is strand (192.168.11.1) + tull1 (192.168.11.30) + tull0 (192.168.11.31), rf=2.

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"The restic minion (default: restic)","default":"restic"},"format":{"type":"string","description":"txt (human readable, default) or json","default":"txt"}},"required":[]}

async def execute(minion="restic", format="txt"): """Read the Restic per-customer backup status report.""" api = env['saltstack.api'] ext = "json" if format == "json" else "txt" return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", f"cat /var/log/garage-backup/restic-status.{ext}")

purpose: list the restore points (snapshots) available for a customer's restic repo when: before a restore — which dates can be restored for this customer? when not: to actually restore (use restic_restore); for S3 bucket sizes (use restic_status) example: {"customer": "dina"} output: restore points with snapshot id, date and tags guardrail: read-only operation, safe note: runs restic-restore.sh --list ON the restic minion (192.168.11.112), where /etc/rclone/<customer>.conf and the restic password live. The command only works THERE — never locally.

{"type":"object","properties":{"customer":{"type":"string","description":"Customer name (= minion name / Garage bucket prefix)"},"minion":{"type":"string","description":"Backup server to run on (default: restic)","default":"restic"}},"required":["customer"]}

async def execute(customer, minion="restic"): """List restore points for a customer (restic-restore.sh --list).""" api = env['saltstack.api'] return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", f"/usr/local/bin/restic-restore.sh {customer} --list")

purpose: restore a customer's Garage bucket from a restic snapshot when: after data loss confirmed — recover from the newest (or a specific) snapshot when not: for a dry look at the contents (set dry_run=true); without confirming the target example: {"customer": "dina", "snapshot": "latest", "dry_run": true} output: restored files (or, with dry_run=true, the snapshot contents — nothing is written) guardrail: dry_run=true is safe; dry_run=false requires human approval (overwrites the target) note: the helper refuses to overwrite a non-empty target without confirmation; default target is /restore/<customer>. Runs ON the restic minion — /etc/rclone/<customer>.conf and the restic password exist only there.

{"type":"object","properties":{"customer":{"type":"string","description":"Customer name"},"snapshot":{"type":"string","description":"Snapshot id or 'latest'","default":"latest"},"target":{"type":"string","description":"Target directory (default /restore/<customer>)","default":""},"dry_run":{"type":"boolean","description":"true = show contents only, write nothing","default":true},"minion":{"type":"string","description":"Backup server to run on (default: restic)","default":"restic"}},"required":["customer"]}
